title: Capture the 2026-11-10 MVP interview as hi criteria and add the 1.0 roadmap, test plan and draft issue mapping
description: Capture the 2026-11-10 MVP interview as hi criteria and add the 1.0 roadmap, test plan and draft issue mapping
no_spec_change_rationale: No requirement text changes: the PR captures Leif's 2026-11-10 interview decisions as new hi criteria (FLOW-21, FLOW-22, DRIVE-24, KNOW-30, LIFE-17 to LIFE-25) and adds roadmap and test-plan documentation. No helper behavior, stage semantics, retention or SpecSync contract changes.
acceptance_criteria: hi check passes with the 22 new criteria (FLOW-21 to FLOW-23, DRIVE-24 to DRIVE-28, KNOW-30 to KNOW-33, LIFE-17 to LIFE-26) and the INTENT.md index regenerated; docs/roadmap-1.0.md defines milestones to 1.0, each tied to one of the four bar items of LIFE-21 with a done definition and its test, ships the human-first redesign (M1 to M3) as one change, Chough 0.6.0, dogfooded on the chough repo before any other repo updates, includes the migration design as settled in the 2026-11-10 design review (session.md frontmatter checkpoint and timeline, agent/ folder, one archived story file per finished session, Markdown records with date+slug names), and re-scopes knowledge to links-never-copies per #235; docs/test-plan-1.0.md covers the per-repo dogfood checklist, the flake tracker and two-week clean window, migration fixtures from every 0.x tag (0.1.0 to 0.5.0) and the host-matrix e2e harness design; the issues exist under the Chough 1.0 milestone: epic #232 with the 19 new issues #213 to #231 and the mapped existing open issues, with #214 and #216 scoped to the settled design; no helper behavior, requirement text, stage semantics, retention or SpecSync contract changes

answers.constraints: hi IDs are never reused or renumbered (hi/AGENTS.md); existing approved criteria are never reworded or removed (KNOW-30 was this change's own unapproved draft, rewritten per Leif's #235 round-2 decision, which closes the KNOW-29 conflict); the FLOW-17 vs FLOW-21 Windows question stays open for Leif; docs must match current main behavior (FLOW-18); removing knowledge/intent and knowledge/archives is contracted librarian behavior (specs/cli/requirements.md) and stays out of this docs change, scoped to the #235 cleanup change
